visual.pie: Ocean acidification makes it harder for corals and shellfish to build calcium carbonate

turnos.t: Fossil fuels are organic carbon: ancient plants and marine remains buried and turned into coal, oil and gas by heat and pressure over millions of years. Limestone is inorganic carbon: shells and corals made of calcium carbonate, buried and cemented.

Slow formation, fast release. It took millions of years to store, and extraction and combustion return it to the atmosphere in decades. CO₂ is a greenhouse gas, so that enhances the greenhouse effect. Some of the extra CO₂ dissolves in the oceans, forms carbonic acid and lowers the pH: ocean acidification. That makes it harder for corals and shellfish to build their shells.
